officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bun-version-file is a supported input on setup-bun@v2 that reads the pinned version from a file (e.g. .bun-version); without an explicit bun-version or bun-version-file input the action falls back through package.json packageManager/engines.bun and finally to 'latest'. The ci.yml change (adding bun-version-file: .bun-version) matches the documented API and eliminates the prior implicit 'latest' float. This validation stands even though the commit is not yet pushed. Re-verified 2026-07-07 (third time, T02:00): no code change since original validation, only a re-check of the push blocker; still holds.
